bible_verses.english: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
“Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cummin, and have neglected the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for making Your heart so clear to us. Teach me to act with justice, extend mercy freely to others, and walk in quiet humility before You every day. Soften my heart whenever I am tempted to rely on my own pride. May my life reflect the grace and goodness You have so generously shown me through Jesus. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: God does not leave us guessing about what pleases Him. Through His Word and the life of Jesus, He has clearly shown us the heart of a faithful walk: doing justice, loving mercy, and walking humbly beside Him. As we sing these scriptural words together, we are invited to pause and align our daily choices with His good and loving will.
